verdict.rationale: Sierra's own materials describe 'Agent Checks and Simulations' that catch problems before release, and the Agent SDK claims you can verify agent performance across many scenarios and avoid regressions. Its tau-bench research shows LLM-simulated user conversations as a method, though that is a research benchmark rather than the product itself. This covers the simulated-conversation half of the story, but only through short marketing statements. Missing for 10: evidence of replaying historical tickets as test cases, in-depth docs on how simulations are built and run, independent or hands-on corroboration.
